question: Can a low-rank model with shared pair weights and leave-one-out training replace the per-pair table, symmetric similarity, graph matrix and full category table without losing accuracy?

arms.loo_mask: leave-one-out plus the earlier 25% random history mask

selection: On seed 0 validation NDCG@20, pick the arm with the higher mean ratio to the earlier category model across POG and POG_DENSE. Test is not used. The pick is tested whichever way it compares.
replication: Train the pick at seeds 1 and 2 on POG and POG_DENSE, and at seeds 0, 1 and 2 on Spotify_sparse and Spotify with no further choices.
primary: Filtered test queries, three-seed per-query means. POG and POG_DENSE: pick vs the earlier category model and vs BundleFuse. Spotify datasets: pick vs BundleFuse where a BundleFuse test reference exists. NDCG@20 and Recall@20. Holm over all of these tests together.

decision.replaces: Pick not significantly behind the category model on NDCG on either POG dataset (Holm p<.05 would count as behind).
decision.versus_bundlefuse: Ahead or behind only with Holm p<.05 on NDCG. Otherwise not separated, which is not equivalence.

scope: Exploratory: POG splits were inspected earlier, and the design follows an audit of the same validation data. Spotify has not been used by any neural model before.

amendments.change: Spotify_sparse has no publication test predictions (that run stopped during selection). Its BundleFuse reference is the general_lift recipe refit, per-query on the 2,497 filtered test queries, matched by bundle. Only the test step changed; model and training code are identical, so the four seed-0 runs already started are unaffected.

Spotify runs stopped on request at epoch 10-12 (validation NDCG about .11 against BundleFuse .22); diagnosis in results/neural_audit/lowrank_spotify_sparse.json. fit() now asks a model for its fast-learning parameters when it defines them; v1 models do not, so v1 training is unchanged. POG and POG_DENSE seeds 1-2 continue under the original plan.
fit() accepts an optional fast_weight_decay; v1 configs do not set it, so v1 training is unchanged.
